stuttgart-things Harvester Demo Lab: Systems, hostnames, services and IP allocation. Source: `system-inventory/inventory.yaml`; the interactive version with the topology diagram is on GitHub Pages under `/inventory/`.

## Virtual machines on Harvester

There are **6 virtual machines** on Harvester (host `harvester`, 192.168.10.110): `app-dev-hv`, `crossplane-mgmt`, `homerun2-dev`, `machinery-hv`, `ollama-gpu`, `tabletennis`. Each one is a cluster node or a single host; Scaffolder templates, catalog locations and VM templates such as `harvester-vm` or `harvester-vm-template` are **not** VMs. Backstage lists each VM as a Resource `<name>-harvester-vm`; Rancher-provisioned cluster nodes carry a pool name in Harvester (e.g. `app-dev-hv-pool1-…`).

## Systems

### app-dev-hv

- **`app-dev-hv-gateway`** 192.168.10.173: Cilium LB VIP (Clusterbook 173:ASSIGNED:DNS:app-dev-hv) of the Gateway app-dev-hv-gateway; *.app-dev-hv.sthings.lab with certificates from the OpenBao PKI on platform.
    - schmetterpause (`schmetterpause.app-dev-hv.sthings.lab`): Table tennis app, admin side.
    - Zählwerk (`zaehlwerk.app-dev-hv.sthings.lab`): Score counter.
    - led-catcher (`led-catcher.app-dev-hv.sthings.lab`): homerun2 LED catcher with its web simulator.
    - core-catcher (`core-catcher.app-dev-hv.sthings.lab`): homerun2 core catcher.
    - omni-pitcher (`omni-pitcher.app-dev-hv.sthings.lab`): homerun2 omni pitcher (API).
    - scout (`scout.app-dev-hv.sthings.lab`): homerun2 scout.
- **`app-dev-hv`** 192.168.10.176 (VM on Harvester): Cluster built by Rancher on a Harvester machine pool (rancher-k3s, 4 CPU / 8 GiB / 64 GiB), ordered as a ClusterStack on machinery-hv. Node address reserved in Clusterbook as app-dev-hv-node; Cilium, homerun2 and tabletennis come from the platform profiles via Argo CD on platform.
    - Kubernetes API (`192.168.10.176:6443`): k3s API server, registered in Argo CD on platform.
    - homerun2 + tabletennis (`192.168.10.176`): Platform profiles: homerun2 stack, schmetterpause (CNPG, backup to s3://app-dev-hv-schmetterpause-cnpg on platform's MinIO) and zaehlwerk.

### crossplane-mgmt

- **`crossplane-mgmt`** 192.168.10.108 (VM on Harvester): VM node of crossplane-mgmt (static lease for MAC BA:69:A8:A3:BA:28). Crossplane for the VM path (XVirtualMachine -> Harvester) and the RancherCluster order tabletennis; Argo CD on platform syncs clusters/crossplane-mgmt (showcase-crossplane-platform / -xrs).
    - Kubernetes API (`192.168.10.108:6443`): API server; also the Argo CD cluster server URL (useFQDNAsServer: false).
    - Crossplane (`192.168.10.108`): RancherCluster, XVirtualMachine and AnsibleRun claims; reached through the Kubernetes API, no ingress.
- **`crossplane-mgmt-vip`** 192.168.10.177: Clusterbook reservation of crossplane-mgmt with DNS (*.crossplane-mgmt.sthings.lab), made by the ClusterbookCluster on platform for the Argo CD registration.

### edge-tt-test1

- **`edge-tt-test1`** 10.100.136.89: LabDA vSphere VM (8 vCPU / 15Gi / 128Gi, Ubuntu 26.04), single-node k3s + Cilium + Flux; the first edge lab cluster and the reference for the others. Folder clusters/edge.
    - Kubernetes API (`10.100.136.89:6443`): k3s API server; kubeconfig in secrets/edge (SOPS).
- **`edge-tt-test1-gateway`** 10.100.136.223: Cilium L2 VIP of edge-gateway, internal names *.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de (LabDA Clusterbook), certificates from the edge CA.
    - schmetterpause (`schmetterpause.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): Table tennis app, admin side.
    - Zählwerk (`zaehlwerk.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): Score counter.
    - OpenBao (`openbao.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): Edge PKI and ACME directory.
    - MinIO console (`minio-console.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): Web UI for MinIO.
    - led-catcher (`led-catcher.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): homerun2 LED catcher.
    - light-catcher-tabletennis (`light-catcher-tabletennis.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): homerun2 light catcher for the table.
    - wled-mock (`wled-mock.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): Stand-in for the WLED strip.
    - demo-pitcher (`demo-pitcher.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): homerun2 demo pitcher.
    - config-viewer (`config-viewer.edge-tt-test1.4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de`): homerun2 config viewer.
- **`edge-tt-test1-play`** 10.100.136.226: Cilium L2 VIP of the players' Gateway. The public Hetzner record *.sthings-edge.com points here; on the sthings-edge box the Opal answers the same names with 192.168.8.21 instead.
    - schmetterpause (players, public) (`10.100.136.226`): Players' side via the public sthings-edge.com record, Let's Encrypt (DNS-01 at Hetzner). FQDN listed under edge-play-gateway.

### harvester

- **`harvester`** 192.168.10.110: Harvester node (enp5s0, MAC 58:47:ca:7d:34:f0), statically addressed. Hosts the VMs of every cluster.
    - Harvester UI (`harvester.sthings.lab`): Web UI, TLS certificate issued by openbao-pki on the platform cluster.
- **`harvester-vip`** 192.168.10.139: Static cluster VIP for Harvester - UI and Kubernetes API. Must sit outside the DHCP pool .100-.149.
    - Kubernetes API (`192.168.10.139:6443`): RKE2 API server of the Harvester cluster. Source of the kubeconfig fetched during install.

### homerun2-dev

- **`homerun2-dev`** 192.168.10.117 (VM on Harvester): VM node of the RKE2 cluster homerun2-dev (12 vCPU / 12Gi / 50Gi, static lease for MAC BA:B3:3E:EA:51:F3; a rebuilt VM needs it updated). Flux syncs clusters/homerun2-dev. Runs the homerun2 and table tennis stacks of the lab.
    - Kubernetes API (`192.168.10.117:6443`): RKE2 API server.
- **`homerun2-dev-gateway`** 192.168.10.171: Cilium LB VIP (Clusterbook 171:ASSIGNED:DNS:homerun2-dev) of the Gateway homerun2-dev-sthings-gateway; *.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab with certificates from the OpenBao PKI on platform.
    - Headlamp (`headlamp.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab`): Kubernetes UI.
    - Flux web (`flux.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab`): Flux UI.
    - sthings-portal (`portal.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab`): homerun2 UIs behind the ZITADEL login (core, notify, led, matrix, light, table, wled, schedule, sound, config, pitch); their direct hosts are gone (#569).
    - omni-pitcher (`omni-pitcher.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab`): homerun2 omni pitcher, only /pitch (bearer token); platform's k8s-pitcher pitches its events here.
    - schedule-pitcher (`schedule-pitcher.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab`): homerun2 schedule pitcher for its agents; the UI is the portal's /schedule.
    - schmetterpause (`schmetterpause.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab`): Table tennis league app; CNPG database backed up to MinIO on platform.
    - Zählwerk (`zaehlwerk.homerun2-dev.sthings.lab`): Scoring API and panel.
- **`homerun2-dev-redis`** 192.168.10.179: Cilium LB address of redis-stack-lb (clusters/homerun2-dev/redis-lb.yaml), own pool with only this IP; Clusterbook 179:ASSIGNED:homerun2-dev-redis, deliberately without DNS.
    - Redis (`192.168.10.179:6379`): The `messages` stream the LED matrix Pi reads in SthingsNet (consumer group homerun2-led-matrix).

### jump-server

- **`geekom`** 192.168.10.50: Mini PC. Entry point into the lab network and launch point for Ansible and Dagger runs.

### labda-dns

- **`labda-dns`** 10.100.136.115: LabDA resolver, the only one that knows 4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de; the edge lab cluster's CoreDNS forwards that zone here.
    - DNS (`10.100.136.115:53`): Zone 4sthings.tiab.ssc.sva.de.

### machinery-hv

- **`machinery-hv`** 192.168.10.105 (VM on Harvester): VM node of the RKE2 cluster machinery-hv (8 vCPU / 16Gi / 80Gi, static lease for MAC BE:64:F3:26:1A:60). Crossplane with the `machinery` profile and Tekton; orders whole clusters as ClusterStacks.
    - Kubernetes API (`192.168.10.105:6443`): RKE2 API server.
    - Crossplane (`192.168.10.105`): ClusterStack API; reached through the Kubernetes API, no ingress.
- **`machinery-hv-gateway`** 192.168.10.178: Cilium LB VIP (Clusterbook 178:ASSIGNED:DNS:machinery-hv) of the cluster Gateway; *.machinery-hv.sthings.lab.
    - Headlamp (`headlamp.machinery-hv.sthings.lab`): Kubernetes UI.
    - Flux web (`flux.machinery-hv.sthings.lab`): Flux UI.
    - machinery (`machinery.machinery-hv.sthings.lab`): Dashboard over the cluster's Crossplane claims (ClusterStack, RancherCluster, ...).

### matrix

- **`matrix-edge`** 192.168.8.30: The same LED matrix Pi (MAC b8:27:eb:d9:33:db) when it travels with the box: Wi-Fi `sthings-edge`, static lease on the Opal, Redis from edge-redis. matrix.sthings.lab points here via the Opal's dnsmasq.
- **`matrix`** 192.168.10.120: Raspberry Pi 3B+ driving the homerun2 64x64 LED matrix (wlan0, MAC b8:27:eb:d9:33:db, static lease). No Kubernetes: homerun2-led-catcher runs under systemd, deployed by the sthings.container play. See hosts/matrix/README.md.
    - LED matrix demo UI and /display API (`matrix.sthings.lab`): Caddy on 443 in front of homerun2-led-catcher (standalone mode), certificate from the OpenBao PKI on platform (role sthings-lab).
    - led-catcher (plain HTTP) (`192.168.10.120:8080`): The catcher itself, also reachable without TLS on the LAN.

### network

- **`opal`** 192.168.8.1: GL.iNet Opal (GL-SFT1200, OpenWrt 18.06). Gateway, DNS (dnsmasq) and DHCP for the table tennis network, own Wi-Fi `sthings-edge`, uplink as a Wi-Fi repeater.
    - dnsmasq (`192.168.8.1:53`): Local domain edge.sthings.lab: one address line per service name to the Gateway VIP .20, sthings-edge.com to the players' VIP .21, and matrix.sthings.lab to the LED matrix Pi.
    - DHCP (`192.168.8.1:67`): Dynamic pool .100-.249 plus static leases for the box (.10), the LED matrix Pi (.30) and the WLED (.31).
- **`ddwrt`** 192.168.10.1: DD-WRT router. Gateway, DNS (dnsmasq, *.sthings.lab) and DHCP for the lab.
    - dnsmasq (`192.168.10.1:53`): DNS for *.sthings.lab. Clusterbook writes its host records here.
    - DHCP (`192.168.10.1:67`): Dynamic pool .100-.149 plus the static reservation for the Harvester node.

### ollama-gpu

- **`ollama-gpu`** 192.168.10.147 (VM on Harvester): Harvester VM (16 vCPU / 16Gi / 256Gi, sthings-u26) with the host's RTX 5060 Ti (16 GB) passed through, static lease for MAC c6:a7:6d:4b:78:1a. Ollama serves gemma3:12b (chat) and bge-m3 (embeddings) for Backstage RAG-AI on platform.
    - Ollama (`ollama-gpu.sthings.lab:11434`): OpenAI-compatible API (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings) for Backstage "Ask AI".

### platform-sthings

- **`platform`** 192.168.10.160: Single-node k3s cluster `platform.sthings.lab` (Cilium LB VIP). Carries the developer-facing platform.
    - Argo CD (`argocd.platform.sthings.lab`): Deploys the platform apps of this cluster.
    - Harbor (`harbor.platform.sthings.lab`): Container registry including the project proxy for upstream images.
    - MinIO (S3) (`artifacts.platform.sthings.lab`): S3 endpoint for the Packer golden images. Served by the sthings-lab private CA, referenced by harvester-images/golden-images.yaml.
    - MinIO console (`artifacts-console.platform.sthings.lab`): Web UI for the artifact bucket.
    - Rancher (`rancher.platform.sthings.lab`): Cluster management UI.
    - claim-machinery-api (`claims.platform.sthings.lab`): Claim rendering API that Backstage calls for self-service provisioning.
    - Backstage (`backstage.platform.sthings.lab`): Developer portal. Catalog entries come from the catalog-info.yaml files in this repo.
    - OpenBao (`openbao.platform.sthings.lab`): PKI for sthings-lab (root CN=sthings.lab) and the Vault API the clusters use: openbao-pki ClusterIssuers log in with Kubernetes auth, Crossplane with AppRoles. Replaced the infra Vault (#152).
    - Clusterbook (`clusterbook.platform.sthings.lab`): Reserves IP and FQDN for new clusters and writes the DNS records to the DD-WRT router. Moved here from the infra cluster.
    - Clusterbook operator (`192.168.10.160`): Reconciles ClusterbookCluster resources against the Clusterbook API on this cluster. No ingress.
    - clusterscope (`clusterscope.platform.sthings.lab`): Map of the lab's clusters from clusters/ in this repo, with live status and endpoint probes for platform itself.
    - Grafana (`grafana.platform.sthings.lab`): kube-prometheus-stack of this cluster (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana). Alerts go to omni-pitcher on homerun2-dev.

### sthings-edge

- **`sthings-edge`** 192.168.8.10: LattePanda Mu (N100, 8 GB, eMMC) on a LAN port of the Opal, static lease for enp1s0. Single-node k3s + Cilium + Flux (role `tt`) for the table tennis stack.
    - Kubernetes API (`192.168.8.10:6443`): k3s API server; kubeconfig ~/.kube/sthings-edge, or through an SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:6443.
- **`edge-gateway`** 192.168.8.20: Cilium L2 VIP of the Gateway `edge-gateway`, internal names *.edge.sthings.lab with certificates from the edge CA (OpenBao on the box). Resolves only inside the Opal LAN.
    - schmetterpause (`schmetterpause.edge.sthings.lab`): Table tennis app, admin side.
    - Zählwerk (`zaehlwerk.edge.sthings.lab`): Score counter (redirects to its login).
    - OpenBao (`openbao.edge.sthings.lab`): PKI of the edge (intermediate signed by the edge root) and ACME directory under /v1/pki/acme/directory.
    - MinIO (S3) (`minio.edge.sthings.lab`): S3 API; bucket for the CNPG backups of schmetterpause.
    - MinIO console (`minio-console.edge.sthings.lab`): Web UI for MinIO.
    - led-catcher (`led-catcher.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 LED catcher.
    - light-catcher (`light-catcher.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 light catcher.
    - light-catcher-tabletennis (`light-catcher-tabletennis.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 light catcher for the table (stream `tabletennis`); drives the WLED at wled-matrix.sthings.lab (.31).
    - wled-mock (`wled-mock.edge.sthings.lab`): Stand-in for the WLED strip.
    - log-sink (`log-sink.edge.sthings.lab`): Viewer of the firmware's log sink: sessions and games the board sent to edge-log-sink (.23), read-only, no login.
    - config-viewer (`config-viewer.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 config viewer.
    - demo-pitcher (`demo-pitcher.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 demo pitcher.
    - scout (`scout.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 scout.
    - core-catcher (`core-catcher.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 core catcher.
    - omni-pitcher (`omni-pitcher.edge.sthings.lab`): homerun2 omni pitcher (API only, no page on /).
- **`edge-play-gateway`** 192.168.8.21: Cilium L2 VIP of the players' Gateway `edge-play-gateway`, public name sthings-edge.com with a Let's Encrypt wildcard (DNS-01 at Hetzner). Inside the Opal LAN the router answers the name locally.
    - schmetterpause (players) (`schmetterpause.sthings-edge.com`): The players' side of schmetterpause, from their phones.
- **`edge-redis`** 192.168.8.22: Cilium LB address of redis-stack-lb (clusters/sthings-edge/lan), own pool with exactly this IP. Only 6379, password-protected.
    - Redis (`192.168.8.22:6379`): The `messages` stream the LED matrix Pi consumes when it is in the table tennis network.
- **`edge-log-sink`** 192.168.8.23: Cilium LB address of the firmware's log sink (clusters/sthings-edge/log-sink), own pool with exactly this IP. The piezo board sends its diagnostic log here directly, without a name.
    - log sink (UDP) (`192.168.8.23:9000`): One JSON line per event over UDP (zaehlwerk-firmware ADR-0004); one file per session and per game. The viewer is log-sink.edge.sthings.lab on edge-gateway.
- **`sthings-edge-kiosk`** 192.168.10.111: The sthings-edge box (MAC 00:e0:4c:0a:f6:ff) when it boots in SthingsNet: role `kiosk` (detected from the gateway), Firefox kiosk with the homerun2-dev tabs, k3s skipped. See clusters/sthings-edge/README.md.

### tabletennis

- **`tabletennis`** 192.168.10.114 (VM on Harvester): Single node (tabletennis-pool1) built by Rancher on Harvester. The address is a DHCP lease from the dynamic pool, not a reservation. homerun2 and tabletennis come from the platform profiles via Argo CD on platform.
    - Kubernetes API (`192.168.10.114:6443`): k3s API server, registered in Argo CD on platform.
- **`tabletennis-gateway`** 192.168.10.180: Clusterbook reservation (180:ASSIGNED:DNS:tabletennis) for the Gateway tabletennis-gateway, *.tabletennis.sthings.lab. Not served: the cluster has no Cilium Gateway controller, so the Gateway stays Pending and the VIP never comes up (checked 2026-10-26).

### wled-matrix

- **`wled-edge`** 192.168.8.31: The same WLED (MAC d4:e9:f4:c3:e9:dc) when it travels with the box: WLED keeps both Wi-Fi networks and joins `sthings-edge` here, static lease on the Opal. wled-matrix.sthings.lab points here via the Opal's dnsmasq; driven by the box's light-catcher-tabletennis (clusters/sthings-edge/README.md, section 13).
    - WLED UI (`192.168.8.31`): The device's own web UI and JSON API.
- **`wled-matrix`** 192.168.10.123: WLED on an ESP32, 36 LEDs. Fed by the light-catcher on homerun2-dev (clusters/homerun2-dev/homerun2-light-catcher-profile.yaml).
    - WLED UI (`wled-matrix.sthings.lab`): The device's own web UI and JSON API.
